# BioMat Lab — scientific intelligence platform

> Public product description and synthetic demo data for an experiment-management and
> scientific-comparison platform for chemistry, materials science and formulation research.
> The working application is private; everything below is example data.

## What it is

BioMat Lab records laboratory experiments in a structured form, understands the scientific role of
each variable, and compares results — two runs of the same project, or a run against a published
paper. It is topic-agnostic: a deep eutectic solvent (DES) lignin extraction project and a protein
purification project use the same engine with different variable definitions.

## Core ideas

- **Project-scoped variable definitions.** Each project declares its own variables, each with a
  name, unit, scientific role, and — for computed values — a formula.
- **Roles are separate from priority.** Role: parameter, result, derived, identifier, covariate.
  Priority (primary/secondary) applies only to results. There is no star-rating of variables.
- **Comparability before comparison.** Two numbers are compared only after their definitions are
  compared: same definition, unit, numerator/denominator, material, measurement method. The result
  is one of: directly comparable, comparable with caveats, not directly comparable, insufficient
  information.
- **Literature values keep their provenance.** Each extracted value keeps the original wording, the
  normalised value, the unit, the page/table, and a status (extracted, verified, corrected, not
  reported, failed).
- **No invented numbers.** A value the paper does not report is marked "not reported", never filled.

## Public demo data (synthetic)

- Product overview: https://feodore06-cyber.github.io/des-lab/
- Variable definitions: https://feodore06-cyber.github.io/des-lab/data/variables.json
- Experiment records: https://feodore06-cyber.github.io/des-lab/data/demo_dataset.json

- Literature extraction: https://feodore06-cyber.github.io/des-lab/data/demo_literature.json
- Product overview (Markdown): https://feodore06-cyber.github.io/des-lab/docs/overview.md
- Features: https://feodore06-cyber.github.io/des-lab/docs/features.md

## Access policy

- Public: this documentation and the synthetic demo data.
- Private (sign-in required, never exposed here): project records, experiment data, accounts,
  attachments, configuration, credentials.

## Crawler policy (robots.txt)

- `Claude-User` — allowed, so a person who asks Claude about this product can have the public page read.
- `Claude-SearchBot` — allowed, for public discoverability.
- `ClaudeBot` — disallowed; the training crawler is not permitted by default.
- Other training crawlers (GPTBot, Google-Extended, CCBot) — disallowed.

## Contact

Public demo only. Private research data is not available through any public endpoint.
